name: com.nexus.core
description: Open source observable MVCS architecture for Unity 6. Features: allocation-free synchronous hot paths after warmup, 4 execution modes, causal tracing, build validation, reactive models, service lifecycle, Game Manager editor, and debug HUD.

samples.description: Attach one component: explicit startup, reactive score model, command, cancellation and context ownership for Unity 6.
A simple counter application demonstrating generic 0-GC commands, reactive model, and mediator bindings in Nexus.
Minimal starter project with Root, Lifecycle, Signal, Command, Model, View, and Mediator — ready to run in 5 minutes.
